claims.sentence: Check to see if transfer case lever is in "N" (neutral) or "P" (Park) for M1123 and A2 vehicles.
Place transmission shift lever in "N" (neutral) or "P" (Park) and select transfer gear range.
Position shift lever in "1" and accelerate the vehicle from 0 mph.
No upshifts should occur in this range.
